text_block_list.text:
There is no training today since Gold
City has
work. I decide to go relax at the
park when...

No way, is that her?! Her face is so
pretty! She's
literally a divine creation.
What does she even
eat every
day—mist?
text_block_list.name: School Girl B

text_block_list.text:
Голд Сити stands before the excited
girls,
surrounded by her staff for a photo
shoot.

Ahh, she looked this way! She's so
pretty!
text_block_list.name: School Girl B

text_block_list.text:
We've got quite the audience, City.
Think you
can keep going?
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
It's okay, I'm used to it. On the other
hand...
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Did Голд Сити just try to catch my eye?
No...
surely I'm imagining things.

Oh, nothing. I thought I saw someone I
know over
there, that's all. They just left
though.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text: Hold on. What is my trainer doing?
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Oh. It seems you have a very enthusiastic
fan!
Impressive commitment.
text_block_list.name: Photographer

text_block_list.text:
Next time, I'll make sure you stay and
watch.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити

text_block_list.text:
Some goody-two-shoes who'd support
anyone
you put in front of them.
text_block_list.name: Голд Сити
